r2.quote: Battery packs are stored in the fire-cell area inside Manchester main stores (bin zones BAT-Z1 to BAT-Z4). In Ledgerline they are booked to warehouse WH-MAN-STR.

r3.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r3.quote: Packs are kept at a state of charge between 30% and 50% while in store. Stores staff must never charge a pack in the store.

r4.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r4.quote: A damaged, swollen, wet or dropped pack is moved at once to the red quarantine bin in fire cell BAT-Z4 and reported to Quality in the same shift with a non-conformance report on screen QA-NCR-02.

r5.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r5.quote: A pack shipped on its own is sent as UN3480 (lithium-ion batteries). A pack fitted to a bike, or packed with it, is sent as UN3481. Every parcel with a pack carries the lithium battery handling label (item PKG-LBL-UN).

r6.quote: Battery end-of-line test results 15 years Quality

r7.quote: Supplier certificates (UN 38.3, ISO) 10 years after the supplier is blocked Purchase

r8.quote: If a battery pack smokes or burns, raise the alarm, leave the area and call the fire wardens. Only trained fire wardens may approach a burning pack.

r9.quote: Attempting to extinguish a burning pack with standard water or carbon dioxide extinguishers, which are ineffective and can cause dangerous flare-ups.

r10.quote: Lithium-cell parts (battery packs, hub motors, chargers and any other item marked lithium-cell in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid UN 38.3 certificate

r11.quote: A cheaper quotation from a new supplier does not by itself justify a change of supplier for a lithium-cell part.

r12.quote: Lithium-cell parts are inspected at acceptable quality level (AQL) 0.65; all other parts at AQL 1.5. Every sample battery pack also gets an open-circuit voltage check.

r13.quote: A supplier of any lithium-cell part (battery packs, hub motors, chargers, and any item marked lithium-cell in the item master) must hold a UN 38.3 certificate.

r14.quote: If the supplier changes the cells or the design of a part (for example a new cell maker or cell chemistry), it must give a fresh test report for that part.

r15.loc_text: p. 4, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes

r3.quote: An invoice line is held for price (HOLD-PRC) when its rate differs from the order rate by more than 2% or by more than £50, whichever is smaller.

sop-ap-002.title: SOP-AP-002 Accounts Payable Period Close
sop-ap-002.summary: Standard operating procedure governing purchase ledger cut-off, accruals, and monthly closing steps across the Manchester and Leeds sites.

r1.quote: Effective 2025-04-01 Owner Marta Kowalski (AP manager) Approved by Grace Whitaker (financial controller) Status CURRENT Classification INTERNAL

r2.quote: This procedure sets out the required steps for closing the purchase ledger at the end of each accounting period across both the Manchester factory and the Leeds unit.

r3.quote: The purchase ledger clerk in Manchester registers incoming delivery notes, matches site invoices, and reviews the unregistered invoice log. The administrator at the Leeds unit collects delivery paperwork, logs workshop receipts, and forwards all matched supplier invoices to central finance.

r4.quote: The accounts supervisor reviews disputed balances, checks parked documents, and verifies the supplier statement reconciliations for high-volume accounts. The financial controller reviews the preliminary aged creditors trial balance, reviews the proposed accruals, and signs off the final close in the system.

r5.quote: 5.1 Working day 1: the GRNI accrual job (JOB-AP-040) runs at 21:00.

r6.quote: 5.2 Working day 3, 12:00: AP cut-off. Invoices received after the cut-off are posted to the next period.

r7.quote: 5.3 Working day 3, afternoon: the AP manager closes the period on AP-PER-11. Ledgerline refuses the close while documents are unposted (ERR-PER-0010).

r8.quote: 5.4 Working day 4: Finance reviews the reverse-charge listing (JOB-AP-045) for the VAT return.

r9.section: What to do when something does not look right
r9.loc_text: p. 4, What to do when something does not look right
r9.quote: When the GRNI accrual job fails to complete: Notify the IT support team that the overnight job did not finish. Do not proceed with manual period closure until the accrual balances have been regenerated

r10.quote: Once the ledger is locked, the finance clerk prints the final aged creditors listing, the period summary report, and the reconciliation sheet. These paper printouts must be countersigned by the finance manager alongside the bank reconciliation. The signed reports are placed in the monthly purchase ledger binder kept in the accounts office in Manchester.

r3.quote: The AP clerk reviews the proposal on AP-PAY-03; the AP manager approves it. The approver may not be the proposer (ERR-PAY-0430).

r4.quote: 5.3 The payment file (JOB-AP-031, format STD18) is released to the bank by 14:30 for same-day processing.

r5.quote: 5.4 Suppliers with unverified bank details are left out automatically (ERR-BNK-0101).

sop-ap-004.title: SOP-AP-004 Supplier Bank Detail Changes
sop-ap-004.summary: Standard operating procedure for verifying and updating supplier bank details to prevent fraud, requiring two-person call-backs and dual-signatory approval.

r1.quote: Version 2.0 Effective 2025-10-01 Owner Marta Kowalski (AP manager) Approved by Grace Whitaker (financial controller) Status CURRENT

r2.quote: Never accept a change of bank details by e-mail alone. Fraudsters copy real suppliers' e-mails.

r3.quote: Call the supplier back on a number taken from its letterhead, website or the supplier master, never from the request itself. Two people from AP must take part in the call.

r1.quote: Document SOP-INV-002 Version 1.3 Effective 2025-01-01 Owner Callum Shaw (stores manager) Approved by Henrik Weber (plant head)

r2.quote: The goods must be isolated immediately in the designated quarantine area so they are not picked for assembly lines.

r4.quote: Goods Inwards and Stores identify non-conforming deliveries, segregate physical items into the designated returns holding pen, and apply red rejected labels.
